title: SKstars at SHROOM: Visions Agreement-Guided Ensembling of Zero-Shot and LoRA-Adapted Vision--Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.24198v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper describes the SKstars submission to SHROOM-Visions 2026, a shared task on fine-grained hallucination detection in large vision-language model outputs. The task requires systems to identify hallucinated character spans, assign hallucination categories, and provide confidence estimates for their predictions. Our approach combines zero-shot predictions from Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct with those of a LoRA-adapted Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct model. The outputs of the two models are integrated through a lightweight ensemble procedure, followed by span refinement and confidence adjustment. We evaluate the main system components on a small internal development subset and report the performance of the submitted system on the official English test set. translated_title: SKstars参加SHROOM：基于一致性引导的零样本与LoRA适配视觉-语言模型集成
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了SKstars团队参加SHROOM-Visions 2026共享任务的提交方案，该任务聚焦于大型视觉-语言模型输出的细粒度幻觉检测。任务要求系统识别幻觉字符片段、分配幻觉类别，并为其预测提供置信度估计。我们的方法将Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct的零样本预测与经LoRA适配的Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct模型的预测相结合，通过轻量级集成流程整合两个模型的输出，随后进行片段细化与置信度调整。我们在小型内部开发子集上评估了系统的主要组件，并报告了提交系统在官方英文测试集上的性能。SKstars取得了0.2902的Cor+Lbl分数，在29支参赛队伍中排名第15位；Cor和IoU分数分别为0.3642和0.3151，在两项指标上均排名第18位。结果表明……
tldr: SKstars团队提出一种一致性引导的轻量级集成方法，将Qwen2.5-VL-72B的零样本预测与LoRA适配的Qwen2.5-VL-7B模型输出相结合，用于视觉-语言模型输出的细粒度幻觉检测，在SHROOM-Visions 2026的29支队伍中排名第15位。
en_tdlr: The SKstars system employs an agreement-guided lightweight ensemble that combines zero-shot predictions from Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct with a LoRA-adapted Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct model for fine-grained hallucination detection in vision-language model outputs, ranking 15th out of 29 teams at SHROOM-Visions 2026.
